source_description: User-supplied monthly NetCDF files; file collection identity is not independently authenticated
annual_aggregation: Calendar-day-weighted mean; all 12 valid months required; no imputation
method: OLS on complete annual means; Newey-West HAC slope covariance with Bartlett weights, n/(n-2) correction, and approximate Student-t(n-2) inference
warnings: Exploratory estimate, not causal attribution or a forecast.
HAC intervals and p-values are approximate, particularly with short records or persistent autocorrelation. Inspect annual.csv, coverage, and sensitivity to HAC lag.
Only complete years are fitted; missing years can bias results.
Nearest grid coordinate, no interpolation or station-level interpretation.
